queries.name: Customer purchases
queries.sql:
SELECT 'customer:' || CAST(customer_id AS VARCHAR) AS source,
       'product:' || CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR) AS target,
       sum(quantity) AS weight
FROM shop.sales.orders
GROUP BY customer_id, product_id

queries.name: Products bought together
queries.sql:
WITH purchases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, product_id FROM shop.sales.orders
)
SELECT a.product_id AS source, b.product_id AS target, count(*) AS weight
FROM purchases a
JOIN purchases b ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id

       'Customer ' || CAST(customer_id AS VARCHAR) AS label,
       'customer' AS kind, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS category
FROM shop.sales.orders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'product:' || CAST(product_id AS VARCHAR) AS id,
       name AS label, 'product' AS kind, category
FROM shop.sales.products
